text: Medication tasks should stay near the front of the day because missed doses carry the highest health risk.
Feeding tasks cover basic nutrition needs and should be preserved before optional enrichment tasks.
An early walk burns energy and reduces destructive behavior later in the day.
Grooming tasks are lower urgency than health and feeding tasks and can shift later without harm.
Enrichment tasks improve wellbeing but are the safest tasks to skip first when time runs short.
